Build the cards

Choose what appears on each side

Country → Capital

Front of card
Back of card

You may leave either side empty while setting up the deck, but studying stays unavailable until both sides contain something. Combine text facts freely. Flag and outline are visual choices, so only one can appear on each side. Sources: REST Countries; GeoNames (CC BY 4.0); Natural Earth; flag-icons.

Build the cards

Choose what appears on each side

State → Capital

Front of card
Back of card

You can combine any fields and reverse them. Studying stays unavailable until both sides contain at least one field. State flag and state outline are visual choices, so only one can appear on each side. Population figures are official U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 estimates. Flags are public-domain state flag SVGs; outlines are sourced from US-State-SVGs.

Anki

Daily limits and order

These options apply to curated and personal study sets.

FSRS 6

Current Anki scheduling

Intervals are calculated from memory stability, difficulty, review history, and desired retention. On a new card, Easy can correctly be a week or longer.

New cards

Learning steps

Use Anki-style delays such as 1m 10m, 2h, or 1d. Easy is calculated by FSRS rather than fixed to five days.
